participantElections.label: Certifying every term and condition of the sentence has been completed (selection)
participantElections.why: you swear to this under penalties of law, and the platform holds no record of what you have completed

participantElections.label: Certifying the time requirements under RSA 651:5, III have been met (selection)
participantElections.why: you swear to this under penalties of law; it turns on dates the platform does not hold

participantElections.label: Certifying you have not been convicted of another crime since completing the sentence (selection)
participantElections.why: you swear to this under penalties of law about your own record since sentence, which the platform has not seen

participantElections.label: Certifying there are no charges pending against you in any other court, except as stated (selection)
participantElections.why: you swear to this under penalties of law about charges in every other court, which the platform has not seen

participantElections.label: Certifying none of the matters sought to be annulled is a violent crime, a felony crime of obstruction of justice, or carried an extended term under RSA 651:6 (selection)
participantElections.why: you swear to this under penalties of law; it is a legal characterisation of your own matters and the platform will not make it for you

participantElections.label: Certifying the matter sought to be annulled has no enhanced penalty for a second conviction (selection)
participantElections.why: you swear to this under penalties of law; it is a legal characterisation of your own matter and the platform will not make it for you

participantElections.label: Court Name (selection)
participantElections.why: this list offers the superior courts; pick the court your case is in, and read the build note about circuit-court cases in build-findings.json

participantElections.label: Marital status — single, married, separated or widowed (selection)
participantElections.why: your marital status is yours to state and the platform holds no marital fact for you

participantElections.label: Whether your own work is full-time or part-time (selection)
participantElections.why: only you can say which your work is

participantElections.label: Whether your spouse's work is full-time or part-time (selection)
participantElections.why: only you can say which your spouse's work is

participantElections.label: Certificate of service — certifying you sent a copy on the date you sign (selection)
participantElections.why: this route requires no service by the participant — the record's rule is “None by the participant. The court provides the copy to the prosecutor.” — so the certificate stays blank; the box is on the form because the same form serves routes where the filer does serve somebody

participantElections.label: Court Name (selection)
participantElections.why: pick the court your case is in; the platform holds no court assignment for you

participantElections.label: Name of the person or entity to receive the record (selection)
participantElections.why: Complete the recipient name if mailing or authorizing a third-party release. This source offers only family and probate courts in its recipient dropdown; do not select an unrelated court. Before mailing, ask the Criminal Records Unit how to enter the intended recipient and complete Section II, including its required notarization. An in-person request for your own record requires only Section I
